rows.field_value_text: [{"pin_description": "高侧 FET 栅极驱动器的升压电容器。从 BOOT 引脚至 PH 引脚连接一个 0.01μF、低 ESR 电容器。", "pin_index": 1, "pin_name": "BOOT", "pin_number": "1", "pin_type": "Output"}, {"pin_description": "内部未连接。", "pin_index": 2, "pin_name": "NC", "pin_number": "2", "pin_type": "-"}, {"pin_description": "内部未连接。", "pin_index": 3, "pin_name": "NC", "pin_number": "3", "pin_type": "-"}, {"pin_description": "稳压器的反馈电压。连接到输出电压分压器。", "pin_index": 4, "pin_name": "VSENSE", "pin_number": "4", "pin_type": "Input"}, {"pin_description": "导通和关闭控制。低于 0.5V，器件停止切换。悬空引脚即可启用。", "pin_index": 5, "pin_name": "ENA", "pin_number": "5", "pin_type": "Input"}, {"pin_description": "接地。连接到 PowerPAD。", "pin_index": 6, "pin_name": "GND", "pin_number": "6", "pin_type": "-"}, {"pin_description": "输入电源电压。采用高质量、低 ESR 陶瓷电容器将 VIN 引脚旁路至靠近器件封装的 GND 引脚。", "pin_index": 7, "pin_name": "VIN", "pin_number": "7", "pin_type": "Input"}, {"pin_description": "高侧功率 MOSFET 的源极。连接至外部电感器和二极管。", "pin_index": 8, "pin_name": "PH", "pin_number": "8", "pin_type": "Output"}, {"pin_description": "必须将 GND 引脚连接到外露焊盘才能正常工作。", "pin_index": 9, "pin_name": "PowerPAD", "pin_number": "9", "pin_type": "-"}]
